item.title: 【環境】 Beyond the engine room
item.description: Technological progress can help address the environmental impacts of shipping, but implementing solutions remains slow and problematic. Understanding shipping as a complex physical, economic and governance system is the key to accelerating a sustainable transition.

item.title: 【環境】 Phased fuel transitions for decarbonizing the Asia–Europe Green Shipping Corridor
item.description: Shipping remains almost entirely reliant on fossil fuels, and identifying viable fuel transition pathways under evolving regulations is a key challenge. A study now evaluates 13 alternative marine fuels for the Asia–Europe corridor, revealing phased transitions shaped by policy design and timing.

item.title: 【環境】 Black carbon emissions and climate impacts of cost-saving Arctic transit shipping through 2050
item.description: Arctic transit routes offer economic gains from shorter voyages but increase regional black carbon deposition on snow and ice. A study now models the economic benefits and climate impacts of Arctic transit shipping through 2050, exploring the trade-offs of different policies.
